bootstrap.method: circular 20-trading-day block bootstrap of each cell daily return sequence

classification: preregistered holding-profile selection across the existing 3x3 risk-parameter grid; no new factor or weight search

gates.D1: full daily returns >=1,300; all nine cells reproduce R314 full stats; 1,000 deterministic bootstrap paths
gates.G7_recent: recent five-start mean >0 and at least 4/5 positive

known_limitations: All nine cells share the same history and are not independent out-of-sample evidence.
The grid was already used for parameter-plateau robustness; this round reuses it only to evaluate holding experience.
R40 local snapshot, industry/factor snapshot bias and canonical data drift remain.
A selected cell would still remain a paper-review candidate, not production authorization.
question: R315 显示中心 60 日/15% 风险预算的随机一年正收益率只有 71.1%、真实滚动一年 63.7%。在 R314 已冻结的 3x3 风险参数邻域中，是否存在同时保留收益和回撤、但年度持有体验更好的格子？
selection_rule: All cells are judged by G1-G9. Among passers, choose the highest bootstrap positive rate, tie-break by bootstrap median. Do not select a grid cell on raw return or maximum Sharpe. If none pass, keep rp60_vol15 unchanged and record negative knowledge.
